_note: THE OBJECT CODEX (seed slice, TD-033). Single source of truth: the dresser places each object where its discovery predicate is true per village; the chronicle can read desc. Schema is JsonUtility-friendly (flat fields); the full allOf/anyOf DSL from OBJECT-CODEX-SPEC comes later. requiresTech/requiresCustom empty = no requirement; minPop/minCrafts/minGen = 0 = no threshold.

objects.desc: a banner of the sky-faith — a people who learned to read the stars raise their sign over the green
the mill — where the village learned to grind grain, famine receded
a marked post — a people who have learned to write leave words for those who come after
a market stall — where enough hands and crafts gather in one place, goods begin to change hands
